in_arabic.name: طريق
in_arabic.meaning: الطريق المستقيم أو الطريقة الصحيحة للوصول إلى الهدف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم طريق مشتق من الفعل 'طَرَقَ' الذي يعني الضرب أو الفتح. في اللغة العربية، يرمز الطريق إلى المسار أو السبيل الذي يقود إلى الهدف أو النجاح. وفي القرآن الكريم، يوصف الطريق المستقيم بأنه طريق الله الذي يجب على المسلمين اتباعه. اسم طريق يوحي بالهداية والاستقامة.

in_urdu.name: طریق
in_urdu.meaning: وہ راستہ جو سیدھا منزل تک پہنچائے
in_urdu.long_meaning: طریق کا نام عربی زبان کے الفعل 'طَرَقَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مارنا یا کھولنا۔ اردو میں، طریق کا مطلب ہے راستہ یا راہ جو کسی منزل یا مقصد تک پہنچاتی ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، طریق المستقیم اللہ کی راہ کو کہا جاتا ہے جس پر مسلمانوں کو چلنا چاہیے۔ یہ نام ہدایت اور راست راست پر چلنے کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: तरीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: तरीक नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'طَرَقَ' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मारना या खोलना। देवनागरी में, तरीक का अर्थ है रास्ता या मार्ग जो किसी लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य तक पहुँचाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, तरीक़-ए-मुस्तकीम को अल्लाह की राह कहा जाता है जिस पर मुसलमानों को चलना चाहिए। यह नाम मार्गदर्शन और सच्चाई का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: طریقی
in_pashto.meaning: هغه لاره چې سم منزل ته رسوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: طریقی نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل 'طَرَقَ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده وهل یا پرانیستل. په پښتو کې، طریقی معنی دادی لار یا لاره چې کوم منزل یا موخې ته رسوي. په اسلامي دود کې، طریقی مستقیم د الله لار بلل کیږي چې مسلمانان باید پرې چلیږي. دا نوم هدایت او سمې لارې پر چللو دلالت کوي.

in_english.name: Tareeq
in_english.meaning: Right path or correct way to reach a goal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tareeq originates from the Arabic root 'ṭ-r-q', which means to strike or to open. In Arabic, the term 'ṭarīq' refers to a path, road, or way that leads to a destination or objective. In Islamic tradition, 'ṭarīq al-mustaqīm' or the straight path is considered the path of Allah that Muslims are encouraged to follow. The name Tareeq connotes guidance, righteousness, and adherence to the true path. It signifies one who is on the right path and is guided towards achieving their goals.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tareeq is of Arabic origin, and in Arabic culture, a Tareeq is a person who follows a certain path in life, be it a career path, academic pursuit, or a religious journey. it can also refer to a guide or leader who shows the way to others. The name is associated with dedication, perseverance, and determination, making it an impressive one for an individual to carry.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the term Tareeq refers to the spiritual path or way leading to Allah. The term is also used to denote a Sufi master or shaykh who guides and instructs the spiritual journey of his disciples. The name Tareeq therefore carries deep spiritual connotations, suggesting a close relationship with the divine and a commitment to the pursuit of spiritual growth and enlightenment. It is a reminder of the journey towards Allah and the importance of following the right path throughout one's life.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's account of his travels, 14th century. In his description of his travels through North Africa, Ibn Battuta mentions a place called Taraghuyt (Tareeq al-Hauz), which was a major caravan stop and a market town.
historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta's travels and writings provide valuable insight into the commercial and cultural connections between the Mediterranean world and the Islamic world during the Middle Ages.

historical_references.reference: Al-Idrisi's Geography, 12th century. Al-Idrisi describes Tarik ibn Ziyad, who conquered Spain for the Umayyad Caliphate in 712 AD, as the founder of Tarik (Tareeq) or Taragona.
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi's Geography is one of the most comprehensive works on the geography of the Islamic world during the Middle Ages, and it provides important information on the expansion of Islamic rule into Spain.
